The Claude Desktop bundle now carries the Linux launcher, and the README says
how to install it from claude.ai/download. VS Code Copilot rejects an SVG icon,
so each icon also ships as WebP. llms.txt is generated by cmd/gen_llms, and the
OpenAI-compatible example in the docs keeps its model identifier gpt-5.

## Summary

A heading of our own, not a bot's.
